title: Existential Prefix Block Compression
statement: Let $P$ be a property of infinite Boolean assignments, let $w,i\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\sigma:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an assignment, and let $\mathrm{rest}$ be a finite sequence of existential or universal quantifiers. The prefix truth obtained by prepending $w$ existential quantifiers to $\mathrm{rest}$ is equivalent to the existence of a Boolean word $\beta$ of length $w$ such that the remaining prefix is true after replacing the assignment on positions $i,\ldots,i+w-1$ by $\beta$ and starting the remaining prefix at position $i+w$.
hypotheses_covered: A property $P$ of infinite Boolean assignments
